bound_example.assumptions: Independent event losses; fixed nine candidates and six mean-risk constraints; predetermined capped action shift <=0.1; paired loss-difference range [-0.1,0.1]; one-sided upper Hoeffding bound with union correction, not a power lower bound

limitations: Invented analytical counterexample; not EEW evidence
Not a proposed training gate, power calculation or actual sample-size requirement
Mean-risk calculation does not certify median error, CVaR, unbounded NLL, sequence independence or distribution shift
